steps.caption: /create_plan answers GH-12 with a wall of Markdown nobody wants to read.
The options become a spec with tried evidence and the same four axes.
build.mjs renders with Pele and refuses any step that names an unknown id.
The decision report is one HTML file with three options as buttons.
The glossary calls it an Artifact inside a Block, and no schema type exists yet.
Choosing posts greenhouse:decision to the host with who chose and when.
A host would turn that into ResolveThread, which records DecisionRecorded.
